_doc: Fitted by scripts/sofa/fit_constants.py from sofa_settled_row. A null value means NOT FITTED — the engine falls back to its documented starting behaviour, which is identity, not a default borrowed from another provider (PLAN §6.0).

K_CENTRE.criterion: smallest K within 0.002 of the minimum median |p_central - outcome|

K_PRICE.criterion: as K_CENTRE, on rows carrying a devigged market price

MAX_LADDER_SIGMA.reason: MAX_LADDER_SIGMA needs rows settled against a live Superbet ladder. Backfilled rows have market_p = NULL and no ladder (PLAN §A9), so they cannot support this constant.
